disclaimer: These starter controls are educational examples for tailoring. They are not production-ready safeguards, legal advice, certification criteria, or evidence that risk is acceptable.

controls.title: Document purpose and prohibited uses
controls.objective: Keep intended outcomes, affected people, authority and prohibited uses explicit and reviewable.

controls.title: Record data provenance and permitted use
controls.objective: Trace material data sources, permissions, quality limits and sensitivity decisions.

controls.title: Define meaningful human review
controls.objective: Give named reviewers sufficient information, authority, time and escalation paths to change outcomes.

controls.title: Perform risk-based third-party due diligence
controls.objective: Record supplier capabilities, limitations, dependencies, change notices, audit rights and exit options.

controls.title: Test misuse and failure scenarios
controls.objective: Exercise credible abuse, unsafe-output, security and recovery scenarios before and after material change.

controls.title: Operate incident and escalation response
controls.objective: Detect, contain, document, communicate and learn from material failures and near misses.

controls.title: Gate material model and workflow changes
controls.objective: Reassess purpose, authority, data, controls and evidence before material changes enter use.

controls.title: Maintain decision and evidence traceability
controls.objective: Connect accountable decisions to inputs, controls, exceptions, evidence and source status.

controls.title: Enforce agentic authority and delegation constraints
controls.objective: Limit tool access, define subagent boundaries, and intercept high-risk action claims in autonomous AI workflows.

controls.title: Test quality of service across affected groups
controls.objective: Define relevant demographic and intersectional groups, approved metrics and release thresholds, then test component and whole-system performance before release and after material change.

controls.title: Test allocation effects and disparities
controls.objective: Evaluate whether decisions, rankings or allocations create unjustified differences in resources or opportunities and record mitigation and residual disparity decisions.

controls.title: Detect stereotyping, demeaning and erasing outputs
controls.objective: Test representational harms across languages, cultures and intersecting groups, including refusal, omission and generated-content failure modes.

controls.title: Maintain a system card and test stakeholder explanations
controls.objective: Keep intended use, components, data, performance, limitations, human authority and monitoring current, and test whether each stakeholder group can understand and act on the explanation provided.

controls.title: Provide timely notice to affected people
controls.objective: Inform affected people about material AI involvement, decision significance, available human contact, explanation and challenge routes in an accessible form.

controls.title: Operate appeal, independent review and remedy
controls.objective: Provide an accessible intake route, conflict-independent reviewer, decision deadline, reasoned outcome and tracked correction, restoration or compensation route where applicable.

controls.title: Enforce Article 50 notices, marking, labelling and provenance
controls.objective: Determine provider and deployer duties, disclose direct AI interaction, apply detectable machine-readable marks to in-scope synthetic content, preserve provenance and test required labels and exceptions.

controls.title: Govern complete data and knowledge-source lifecycles
controls.objective: Trace datasets, prompts, retrieval corpora, embeddings and derived data through origin, transformation, permission, quality, use, retention, deletion and change impact.

controls.title: Assure annotation and ground-truth quality
controls.objective: Define annotation instructions, annotator competence, sampling, agreement, dispute resolution, drift review and known ground-truth limitations.

controls.title: Apply privacy obligations across the AI lifecycle
controls.objective: Record actor roles, purposes, lawful basis, necessity, minimisation, data-subject rights, retention, deletion and privacy-risk decisions for personal data used by or exposed to AI.

controls.title: Operate the GPAI provider obligation pack
controls.objective: For in-scope providers, maintain technical documentation, downstream information, copyright policy, training-content summary and Code-of-Practice or equivalent compliance evidence.

controls.title: Operate the GPAI deployer and integrator control pack
controls.objective: Record model selection, contractual rights, provider documentation, configuration, downstream context, evaluation, monitoring and material modifications for GPAI use.

controls.title: Evaluate and mitigate GPAI systemic risk
controls.objective: Identify model-capability, misuse, cyber, autonomy, societal and cascading risks; run proportionate evaluations and adversarial tests; document mitigations and unresolved systemic-risk findings.

controls.title: Classify and report serious incidents within applicable clocks
controls.objective: Start a jurisdiction-specific clock at detection, preserve evidence, determine reportability, notify competent authorities and affected parties, and document updates and closure without delaying containment.

controls.title: Gate withdrawal, retirement and decommissioning
controls.objective: Plan service withdrawal, customer transition, model and data disposition, capability revocation, residual monitoring and accountable closure before operation ends.

controls.title: Test accessible AI interactions and generated outcomes
controls.objective: Test interfaces, notices, explanations, generated content, review and appeal routes with assistive technologies and representative disabled users across supported modalities.

controls.title: Measure and govern AI environmental performance
controls.objective: Define material energy, carbon, water and hardware indicators, establish baselines and budgets, compare alternatives and gate material environmental regressions.

controls.title: Measure role-based AI literacy effectiveness
controls.objective: Map role competencies, deliver contextual learning, assess demonstrated ability, refresh after material change and track whether trained people apply required controls.

controls.title: Establish AIMS context, leadership, policy and objectives
controls.objective: Define organizational scope, interested parties, accountable leadership, AI policy, measurable objectives, roles, resources and controlled documented information.

controls.title: Operate risk-based AIMS internal audits
controls.objective: Maintain an independent audit programme covering system and organizational controls, evidence quality, nonconformities and follow-up verification.

controls.title: Perform management review and corrective action
controls.objective: Review AIMS performance, source and context changes, incidents, audit results, resources and objectives; assign corrective actions and verify effectiveness before closure.

controls.title: Enforce PALO-AI production admission and non-bypassable execution
controls.objective: Refuse production claims unless workload identity, tenant isolation, durable state, external key custody, policy enforcement, trusted connectors, outcome verification and recovery controls are configured and tested.
